whoItsFor: Developers and AI engineers building agents or LLM apps that need clean, LLM-ready web data (markdown, JSON, screenshots) without managing scraping infrastructure. Also suited to teams that want a self-hostable or hosted web data API.
useCases: Scrape a single URL into clean markdown or structured JSON for LLM context
Crawl or map an entire documentation site to build a retrieval knowledge base
Give an AI agent web search and browsing via MCP or the Agent endpoint
